description:
Transcript of a YouTube video from its captions: timed segments, joined plain text, chosen language and the list of available caption languages.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id`.
Returns: video_id (string), language (string), language_name (string), is_auto_generated (boolean), available_languages (array<object>), segment_count (integer), text (string), segments (array<object>).

lang.description: Caption language code such as en, de, pt-BR or es-419. Default: the video's original language. Example: "en"

url.description: YouTube video URL (watch, youtu.be, shorts, live or embed link; a bare ID also works). Example: "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ"

name: youtube_transcript
title: YouTube transcript
